q20771.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is just after a bend.

explain.short: Your side can cross because you can see far ahead. That is the case just after a bend: the other side, still in the bend, cannot see.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'subito dopo una curva' (just after a bend): after, not before.

sceneParams.caption: Mixed line: placed just after a bend
lines: Dashed on your side: you may cross

q20772.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture allows overtaking even by crossing both lines.

explain.short: The line next to you is dashed, so you may cross it. When you cross it, you also cross the solid line beside it to overtake.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'tutte e due le strisce' (both lines): crossing both is fine when you start from the dashed side.

sceneParams.caption: From the dashed side you may cross both lines
lines: Dashed on your side: you may cross
You may cross both lines to overtake

q20773.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is after a level crossing.

explain.short: After a level crossing (railway crossing) you can see the road ahead again. So the side leaving the crossing gets the dashed line.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'dopo un passaggio a livello' (after a level crossing): after, so your side can cross.

sceneParams.caption: Mixed line: placed after a level crossing
lines: Dashed on your side: you may cross

q20774.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture can be on the downhill part of a hump.

explain.short: On the downhill part of a hump (crest of a hill) you see the road below. The uphill side cannot see, so it gets the solid line.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'nel tratto in discesa' (on the downhill part): downhill = you see, so dashed for you.

sceneParams.caption: Mixed line: dashed on the downhill side
lines: Downhill side: you see far, dashed

q20775.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture also lets the oncoming vehicle cross the lines.

explain.short: The oncoming vehicle has the solid line on its side. A solid line may not be crossed, so only you may cross.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'anche al veicolo che viene di fronte' (also the oncoming vehicle): no, its side is solid.

sceneParams.caption: Only the dashed side may cross, not oncoming traffic
lines: Your side: dashed, you may cross

q20776.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is, as a rule, on one-way roads.

explain.short: A mixed line separates two opposite directions. It is used on two-way roads, not on one-way roads.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'di norma, su strade a senso unico' (as a rule, on one-way roads): it is for two-way roads.

sceneParams.caption: Mixed line is for two-way roads, not one-way

q20777.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is on the uphill part of a hump.

explain.short: Going uphill to a hump you cannot see what is coming. So the uphill side gets the solid line, not the dashed one.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'in salita' (uphill): uphill you are blind, so solid line.

sceneParams.caption: Uphill to a hump you can't see: solid, not dashed
lines: Dashed side is the downhill one

q20778.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is just before a junction.

explain.short: Just before a junction overtaking is dangerous. The side going towards it does not get a dashed line to cross.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'subito prima di un incrocio' (just before a junction): before = danger ahead, no dashed side.

sceneParams.caption: Not placed just before a junction
lines: Dashed side: where you see far

q20779.en: For the vehicle going in the direction of the arrow, the dashed line in the picture is before a bend.

explain.short: Before a bend you cannot see round it, so your side would get the solid line. The dashed side is the one just after the bend.
explain.rule: With a mixed line you may cross only from the dashed side. The solid side may not cross.
explain.trap: 'prima di una curva' (before a bend): the dashed side comes after a bend, not before.

sceneParams.caption: Dashed side is after a bend, not before
lines: Before a bend: you can't see, solid
Dashed side: just after the bend

q20780.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge mean no parking.

explain.short: Yellow and black stripes on the kerb are the marking for no parking (divieto di sosta) along that side.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'divieto di sosta' (no parking): parking only, not stopping.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow-black kerb: no parking

q20781.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture are placed along the vertical part of the kerb.

explain.short: These stripes are painted on the upright side of the kerb, the part drivers see from the road.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'parte verticale' (vertical part): the side of the kerb, not the flat top.

sceneParams.caption: Painted on the upright side of the kerb
lines: Painted on the vertical side of the kerb

q20782.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge mean that you cannot park on that side of the road.

explain.short: The marks forbid parking (sosta) along that side. This is the same as a no-parking ban.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'non è possibile sostare' (you cannot park) is the same as 'divieto di sosta'.

sceneParams.caption: No parking on this side of the road

q20783.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge allow stopping.

explain.short: These marks ban only parking. A short stop (fermata), for example to let someone get out, is still allowed.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'consentono la fermata' (allow stopping): yes, only parking (sosta) is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Short stop allowed, parking not

q20784.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge mean that only buses may park.

explain.short: The marks are a no-parking ban for everyone. They do not reserve the space for buses.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'solo agli autobus' (only for buses): no, the ban is for all vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: No parking for anyone, not a bus space

q20785.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge warn of an obstacle in the middle of the carriageway.

explain.short: The marks are on the kerb at the side of the road. They mean no parking, not an obstacle in the middle.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'ostacolo al centro della carreggiata' (obstacle in the middle of the road): wrong meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Kerb marks mean no parking, not an obstacle
lines: On the kerb, at the side

q20786.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge warn pedestrians to watch out for the step.

explain.short: The marks are for drivers, not pedestrians. They mean no parking on that side.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'avvertono i pedoni' (warn pedestrians): no, they speak to drivers.

sceneParams.caption: For drivers: no parking, not a step warning

q20787.en: The yellow and black marks in the picture painted on the kerb edge mean that stopping is also forbidden.

explain.short: The marks ban only parking. A short stop (fermata) is still allowed.
explain.rule: Yellow-black kerb = no parking on that side; a short stop is allowed.
explain.trap: 'anche la fermata' (stopping too): no, only parking is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Only parking banned; a short stop is allowed

q20788.en: The markings in the picture show an area for public line buses to stop.

explain.short: The yellow area with zig-zags at the ends is the bus stop for public line buses (autobus di linea).
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'in servizio pubblico di linea' (public line service): city and regular buses.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow zig-zag area: public bus stop

q20789.en: The markings in the picture show the space where public line buses and trolleybuses stop.

explain.short: The bus stop marking is for buses and also for trolleybuses (filobus, electric buses on overhead wires) on a public line.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'autobus e filobus' (buses and trolleybuses): both use this stop.

sceneParams.caption: Stop for buses and trolleybuses

q20790.en: The zig-zag line of the markings in the picture helps buses pull in and pull out again.

explain.short: A bus is long. The zig-zag spaces at each end give it room to move to the kerb and to leave again.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'accostamento' (pulling in to the kerb) and 'ripartire' (setting off): that is the job of the zig-zag.

sceneParams.caption: Zig-zags: room to pull in and pull out
lines: Room to pull in and pull out

q20791.en: The markings in the picture forbid parking but not stopping, even in the parts with the yellow zig-zag line.

explain.short: Other vehicles may not park (sosta) anywhere in the bus stop. A short stop (fermata) is allowed, zig-zags included, if you do not block the bus.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'anche nelle parti con striscia gialla a zig zag' (also on the zig-zag parts): the same rule there too.

sceneParams.caption: Bus stop: no parking, short stop allowed
lines: No parking in the whole area

q20792.en: The markings in the picture show the space where public line articulated buses stop.

explain.short: Articulated buses (autosnodati, long bendy buses) on a public line are buses too. They use the same stop.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'autosnodati' (articulated buses): long buses, still buses.

sceneParams.caption: Articulated line buses use this stop too

q20793.en: The markings in the picture show the space reserved for parking, taxis included.

explain.short: The space is for public line buses to stop. Taxis are not line buses, and nobody may park there.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'anche dei taxi' (taxis too): taxis have their own spaces.

sceneParams.caption: Bus stop: not for taxis, no parking

q20794.en: The markings in the picture do not allow cars to drive inside the marked area.

explain.short: The marking bans parking, not driving. Cars may drive through the area when no bus needs it.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'non consente ... di circolare' (does not allow driving): wrong, only parking is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Cars may drive through the bus stop area

q20795.en: The markings in the picture do not allow parking 20 metres before the yellow zig-zag line.

explain.short: The parking ban covers only the marked area, zig-zags included. The marking says nothing about 20 metres before it.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: '20 metri prima' (20 metres before): an invented distance.

sceneParams.caption: Ban only inside the marking, not 20 m before

q20796.en: The markings in the picture forbid lorries to drive inside the marked area.

explain.short: The marking bans parking, not driving. Lorries, like cars, may drive through the area.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'vieta agli autocarri di circolare' (bans lorries from driving): no, only parking is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries may drive through too

q20797.en: The markings in the picture can also be made with white lines.

explain.short: Bus stop markings are always yellow. Yellow on the road marks spaces reserved for special uses.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'di colore bianco' (white): no, bus stops are yellow.

sceneParams.caption: Bus stop markings are always yellow

q20798.en: The markings in the picture allow cars to park from 8 p.m. to 8 a.m.

explain.short: The marking has no time limits. Parking in the bus stop is banned at all hours.
explain.rule: A yellow bus stop is for public line buses. Other vehicles may not park there, but they may stop briefly and drive through.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 20.00 alle ore 8.00' (from 8 p.m. to 8 a.m.): invented time window.

sceneParams.caption: No parking at any hour in the bus stop

q20799.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle C must turn right.

explain.short: C's lane is led by the island straight into the side road on its right. It cannot cross the island or the solid line.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'deve' (must): C has only one way, to the right.

sceneParams.caption: C: only one way, right

q20800.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle B must turn right.

explain.short: B comes from the side road. The island stops it from turning left, so it must turn right.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'deve' (must): B cannot turn left, the island is in the way.

sceneParams.caption: B: must turn right

q20801.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle A must go straight on.

explain.short: A would have to cross the island and the solid line to turn left. That is forbidden, so A must go straight.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'deve andare diritto' (must go straight): no left turn for A.

sceneParams.caption: A: must go straight
lines: Island and solid line block A's left

q20802.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle C may go in any direction.

explain.short: The island channels C into the side road. C has only one way: to the right.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi direzione' (any direction): no, only right.

sceneParams.caption: C may not go any way: right only

q20803.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle B may turn left, giving way to vehicle A.

explain.short: B may not turn left at all: the island is in the way. Giving way does not change that.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'dando la precedenza' (giving way): sounds polite, but the left turn is still forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: B may not turn left, even giving way

q20804.en: With the traffic island shown in the picture, vehicle A may turn left, giving way to vehicle C.

explain.short: To turn left A would cross the island and the solid line. That is forbidden, so A must go straight.
explain.rule: A traffic island may not be crossed. Here it lets every vehicle go only one way: A straight, B and C right.
explain.trap: 'dando la precedenza' (giving way): the turn is forbidden anyway.

sceneParams.caption: A may not turn left, even giving way
lines: Island and solid line block A

q20805.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle C may go straight on.

explain.short: The guide lines are dashed: they guide but do not force a direction. C may go straight (or turn right).
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'può' (may): C is free, not forced to turn.

sceneParams.caption: Dashed guide lines: C may go straight

q20806.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle B may turn left, but must give way to vehicle A.

explain.short: Nothing blocks B's left turn. But when it turns left onto the main road it crosses A's path, so it gives way to A.
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'dando però la precedenza' (but giving way): here the turn is allowed, and giving way is required.

sceneParams.caption: B may turn left, giving way to A

q20807.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle A may go in any direction.

explain.short: There is no island and no solid line in A's way. A may go straight or turn left into the side road.
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'qualsiasi direzione' (any direction): true here, the lines are only dashed.

sceneParams.caption: A may go any way: dashed lines only

q20808.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle C must turn right.

explain.short: Dashed guide lines do not force a direction. C may turn right, but it may also go straight.
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'deve' (must): C may turn, it is not forced to.

sceneParams.caption: C is not forced to turn right

q20809.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle B must turn right.

explain.short: Nothing blocks B's left turn here. B may turn right or left (giving way to A).
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'deve' (must): B may also turn left.

sceneParams.caption: B is not forced right; left is allowed too
lines: No island: B may turn left too
Left turn: give way to A

q20810.en: With the guide lines in the picture, vehicle A must go straight on.

explain.short: There is no island blocking A. A may go straight or turn left into the side road.
explain.rule: Dashed guide lines only guide you; they do not force a direction. Normal give-way rules still apply.
explain.trap: 'deve andare diritto' (must go straight): A may also turn left.

sceneParams.caption: A is not forced straight; it may turn left
lines: A may go straight or left

q20811.en: All three lanes shown in the picture let the driver go straight on.

explain.short: Each of the three lanes allows going straight. Left lane: straight or left; middle: straight; right: straight or right.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'Tutte e tre' (all three): yes, straight is allowed in each lane.

sceneParams.caption: Straight is allowed in all three lanes

q20812.en: The left lane shown in the picture lets the driver go straight on or turn left.

explain.short: The left lane is for drivers going straight or turning left.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'dritto o svoltare a sinistra' (straight or left): both are allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Left lane: straight or left

q20813.en: The middle lane shown in the picture lets the driver only go straight on.

explain.short: The middle lane is between the two turning lanes. From it you may only go straight.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): here it is right, the middle lane is straight only.

sceneParams.caption: Middle lane: straight only

q20814.en: The right lane shown in the picture lets the driver go straight on or turn right.

explain.short: The right lane is for drivers going straight or turning right.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'diritto o svoltare a destra' (straight or right): both are allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Right lane: straight or right

q20815.en: You may change lane as long as the lines are still broken (dashed).

explain.short: Dashed lines may be crossed, so you can change lane there. Once the lines become solid, you stay in your lane.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'finché' (as long as): only while the lines are dashed.

sceneParams.caption: Change lane only while lines are dashed

q20816.en: The vehicle shown in the picture may turn left while staying in the same lane.

explain.short: The car is in the left lane. The left lane allows a left turn, so it does not need to change lane.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'rimanendo nella stessa corsia' (staying in the same lane): it is already in the left lane.

sceneParams.caption: Car in the left lane: may turn left
lines: Car is in the left lane

q20817.en: The left lane shown in the picture lets the driver only turn left.

explain.short: The left lane allows a left turn, but also going straight.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): wrong, straight is allowed too.

sceneParams.caption: Left lane: straight too, not left only

q20818.en: The right lane shown in the picture is reserved for slow vehicles.

explain.short: The lanes here are chosen by direction, not by speed. The right lane is for straight or right.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'riservata ai veicoli lenti' (reserved for slow vehicles): invented, it is about direction.

sceneParams.caption: Right lane is for straight or right, not slow traffic

q20819.en: The right lane shown in the picture lets the driver only turn right.

explain.short: The right lane allows a right turn, but also going straight.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): wrong, straight is allowed too.

sceneParams.caption: Right lane: straight too, not right only

q20820.en: With the markings shown in the picture, the driver may change lane even by crossing the solid line.

explain.short: A solid line may never be crossed. You may change lane only where the lines are dashed.
explain.rule: Before a junction: left lane = straight or left, middle = straight only, right = straight or right. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'anche superando la striscia continua' (even crossing the solid line): never allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Never cross the solid line to change lane

q20821.en: Lanes A, B and C shown in the picture do not let the driver go straight on.

explain.short: No lane has a straight arrow. A turns left, B turns left or right, C turns right.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'non consentono' (do not allow): right, there is no straight arrow.

sceneParams.caption: No straight arrow in any lane

q20822.en: Lane A shown in the picture lets the driver turn left only.

explain.short: Lane A has only left-turn arrows. From A you may only turn left.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'solo a sinistra' (left only): yes, A has only left arrows.

sceneParams.caption: Lane A: left only

q20823.en: With the markings in the picture, the driver may change lane where the lane lines are still broken (dashed).

explain.short: Dashed lane lines may be crossed. Where they become solid, near the junction, you stay in your lane.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'ancora discontinue' (still dashed): only there.

sceneParams.caption: Change lane only on the dashed part

q20824.en: Lanes A, B and C shown in the picture are two-way.

explain.short: All the arrows point the same way, towards the junction. The three lanes go in one direction only.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'doppio senso' (two-way): no, all lanes go the same way.

sceneParams.caption: All three lanes go the same way
lines: All arrows point to the junction

q20825.en: Lanes A, B and C shown in the picture let the driver go in all directions.

explain.short: No lane allows going straight. A only left, B left or right, C only right.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'tutte le direzioni' (all directions): straight is missing.

sceneParams.caption: Not all directions: no straight

q20826.en: Lane B shown in the picture lets the driver turn and go straight on.

explain.short: Lane B's arrows point left and right only. You may turn, but not go straight.
explain.rule: Arrows in a lane are an order: follow the direction of your lane. Change lane only on dashed lines.
explain.trap: 'e di proseguire diritto' (and go straight): no straight arrow in B.

sceneParams.caption: Lane B: left or right, not straight
lines: Lane B arrows: left or right

q20827.en: Lane A shown in the picture lets the driver only turn left.

explain.short: Lane A has only left-turn arrows. From A you may only turn left.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): right here, A is left only.

sceneParams.caption: Lane A: left only

q20828.en: Lane B shown in the picture lets the driver go straight on and turn left.

explain.short: Lane B's arrows point straight and left. Both are allowed.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'diritto e di svoltare a sinistra' (straight and left): both arrows are there.

sceneParams.caption: Lane B: straight or left
lines: Lane B arrows: straight or left

q20829.en: With the markings in the picture, lane C is the only one that lets you turn right.

explain.short: Only lane C has a right-turn arrow. A turns left, B goes straight or left.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'l'unica' (the only one): yes, only C has a right arrow.

sceneParams.caption: Only lane C turns right

q20830.en: With the markings in the picture, you may change lane as long as the lines are still broken (dashed).

explain.short: Dashed lines may be crossed. Where they become solid, near the junction, you stay in your lane.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'fino a che' (as long as): only while the lines are dashed.

sceneParams.caption: Change lane only on the dashed part

q20831.en: All three lanes shown in the picture let the driver go straight on.

explain.short: Lane A has only left arrows. Only B and C allow going straight.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'Tutte e tre' (all three): A does not allow straight.

sceneParams.caption: Lane A: left only, not straight

q20832.en: With the markings in the picture, lane A is the only one that lets you turn left.

explain.short: Lane B also has a left arrow. So both A and B allow a left turn.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'l'unica' (the only one): no, B turns left too.

sceneParams.caption: Left turn from A and also from B

q20833.en: Lane B shown in the picture lets the driver only go straight on.

explain.short: Lane B's arrows point straight and left. You may also turn left from B.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): wrong, B also turns left.

sceneParams.caption: Lane B: straight or left, not straight only
lines: Lane B arrows: straight or left

q20834.en: Lane C shown in the picture lets the driver only turn right.

explain.short: Lane C's arrows point straight and right. You may also go straight from C.
explain.rule: Each lane goes only where its arrows point: A left, B straight or left, C straight or right.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only): wrong, C also goes straight.

sceneParams.caption: Lane C: straight or right, not right only
lines: Lane C arrows: straight or right
